summary_hint: borrower(s), loan purpose and amount, subject property, occupancy intent

typed_core.name: borrower_legal_name
typed_core.why: ID-1 — name consistency across five documents

typed_core.name: borrower_name_2
typed_core.why: co-borrower; a joint application is the norm
typed_core.prompt_hint: URLA 2020 uses a separate form per borrower; the legacy 1003 uses parallel columns

typed_core.name: borrower_count
typed_core.why: disambiguator — how many parties the file has

typed_core.name: social_security_number
typed_core.prompt_hint: Never place an SSN in additional_sections — catch-all values are stored unmasked

typed_core.name: current_address_type
typed_core.why: KNOWN TRAP — the MISMO parser stores the first ADDRESS regardless of type, so a mailing address can masquerade as a residence and produce false ID-4 mismatches. Confirmed in the sample MISMO: only 3 of 10 ADDRESS elements carry an AddressType
typed_core.prompt_hint: State whether the address is PRESENT/RESIDENCE or MAILING. Never report a mailing address as the current residence

typed_core.name: stated_monthly_income_total
typed_core.why: IN-1 — compares STATED income to documented; the catalog has income components but no single stated total to read

typed_core.name: loan_purpose
typed_core.why: PE-1; also the loan.purpose signal PC-2/PC-7 need to scope a refinance to not_applicable

typed_core.name: property_value_or_purchase_price
typed_core.why: PC-2 — 'compare contract price to MISMO price'

typed_core.name: subject_property_address
typed_core.why: PC-3, PR-7, TI-1, RE-1 — matched across four documents

typed_core.name: declaration_primary_residence
typed_core.why: OC-1 — occupancy.consistent_with_signals reads exactly this class of declaration

typed_core.name: demographic_section_present
typed_core.why: ID-6 completeness — a PRESENCE flag only, so the regulated HMDA responses are never pulled into typed core
typed_core.prompt_hint: Report only whether the demographic section is present and answered. NEVER extract the ethnicity/race/sex responses themselves

typed_core.name: application_signed_date
typed_core.why: DC-1 — TRID window vs the application date

typed_core.name: is_signed
typed_core.why: ID-6 completeness — an unsigned 1003 is incomplete

typed_core.name: form_version
typed_core.why: ID-6 disambiguator — URLA 2020 and the legacy 1003 have different required sections, so 'required fields' differ by version
typed_core.prompt_hint: Determine this FIRST — it dictates where every other field lives

rejected.name: 12 of the 15 declarations

rejected.name: loan_originator_* (7 fields)
rejected.reason: LOS metadata; no rule reads it

encoding_variations: URLA 2020 vs the legacy 1003 — different section numbering and field names
Declarations are Y/N checkboxes, sometimes lettered (a-m), sometimes numbered
Multi-borrower: URLA 2020 uses a separate form per borrower; the legacy 1003 uses parallel columns — this changes how borrower_name_2 is found

open_questions.q: Does a PDF 1003 need extraction at all, given MISMO is authoritative?
open_questions.recommendation: full typed core — the PDF is the cross-check against MISMO, and if the two can disagree that is an unwritten rule worth surfacing GEET'S DECISION (LP-439): full typed core (the PDF is the cross-check against MISMO).

open_questions.q: No PiiKind exists for DOB or ADDRESS
options: store as date/str and rely on snapshot handling
open_questions.recommendation: add both — the credit report needs them too GEET'S DECISION (LP-438): mask account-like identifiers (policy/account/plan numbers, wire/ACH trace, check references) via _PII_FIELDS; leave addresses and public-record case numbers PLAIN; DOB is unmasked (pii null).

open_questions.q: 12 unused declarations — include now or when the credit rules are written?
open_questions.recommendation: defer — cheap to add later, and unused fields are cost

open_questions.q: MISMO's AddressType is sparse (3 of 10 in the sample)
open_questions.recommendation: both — the PDF field is the cross-check, but the MISMO mapping is where ID-4's false mismatches originate

notes: MISMO SAMPLE VERIFIED (DU_MISMO_16973013.xml): EMPLOYMENT x3, LIABILITY x7, OWNED_PROPERTY, CURRENT_INCOME_ITEM x3, DECLARATION x2, and EmploymentBorrowerSelfEmployedIndicator x3 are all present. All four proposed nested lists were dropped as a result — ~20 plumbing sites avoided, the single largest cost saving in the top ten.
EmploymentBorrowerSelfEmployedIndicator exists in MISMO — IN-12's self-employment gate may be available directly, without the tax-return Schedule C path built in LP-421/422.
LiabilityExclusionIndicator and LiabilityPayoffStatusIndicator are present in MISMO — CR-1 and CR-3 may be blocked on wiring rather than extraction.
